description: Paths and options for the framework's checker (scripts/check-vocabulary.mjs), contract tests (tests/contracts) and release script (scripts/release-tag.mjs). Paths are relative to the repository root. designSystem: the design system the project uses, where its generated files go and which targets (regenerate with the plugin's scripts/design-system.mjs build <id> --out <out> --targets <targets>). theme.pairs: colour pairs the project adds on top of the design system's own (tokens.json contrast.pairs), as { fg, bg, min } with CSS custom property names.
